speaker: customer
text: Hello. This is Victor Lane. I run two car washes. A friend told me to call you.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you for calling, Victor. What is going on with the business?

speaker: customer
text: Revenue has been flat for two years. My friend says consulting helped him, but I am honestly not sure it works.

speaker: consultant
text: That is a fair concern. What have you tried so far?

speaker: customer
text: Discounts, a loyalty card, new signs. Nothing changed much.

speaker: consultant
text: In cases like yours, the Growth Package usually works best. Six sessions over three months, for nine hundred and fifty dollars.

speaker: customer
text: And what results can you guarantee for that?

speaker: consultant
text: I cannot guarantee a number. What I can promise is a clear plan, based on your own data, and support while you test it.

speaker: customer
text: So I pay nine hundred and fifty dollars, and maybe nothing happens.

speaker: consultant
text: There is always some risk. That is why many clients start with a single session for one hundred and eighty dollars.

speaker: customer
text: I have paid people for advice before. I got a nice report and nothing else.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand that experience. My sessions focus on actions you can test the next week, not on reports.

speaker: customer
text: Everyone says that. I am still not convinced, to be honest.

speaker: consultant
text: That is okay. Is there anything that would help you decide?

speaker: customer
text: Not really. I will think about it, but I don't want to be called about it.

speaker: consultant
text: Of course. I will not follow up unless you contact me.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you, Victor. Good luck with the car washes.
